digest.component_or_area: LLM provider inference and model resolution
propositions: gemini-* model ids map to provider name google_genai via _PROVIDER_PREFIXES, but google_genai is not a member of _pydantic_ai_known_providers() or ProviderSession._builders, causing call-time LLMConfigError

model_classes._resolve_target composes a qualified provider string using inferred provider names verbatim, and when inferred name is unresolvable, ProviderSession.provider_factory raises with unknown provider error
pydantic-ai 1.107.1 recognizes google as the canonical provider name for Gemini Developer API and includes google:gemini-* ids in known_model_names(), but does not recognize google_genai
_PROVIDER_PREFIXES must map gemini to a provider name that exists in both _pydantic_ai_known_providers() and KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES to ensure bare gemini-* ids are resolvable

anthropic_model._pai_model contains a separate _PAI_PROVIDER_PREFIX table with google_genai->google-gla mapping that masks the inference defect for the runner.run path but not for the model-class ladder path
alternative providers google-gla, google-vertex, and vertexai are deprecated in pydantic-ai v2.0, making them unsuitable for forward compatibility
